steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Did I fall asleep?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Oh, now I remember... I was helping count the casualties till late last night, and I went straight to bed after I got back...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Looks like the sunrise and sunset have gone back to normal...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Kroos, wake up!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Hfff...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Kr—oo—s—!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ngh... guh.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: *Yawn*... Morning, Lava...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I've been meaning to ask, but how do you manage to sleep so well with that crossbow as a hug pillow?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Well, sleep is... important... yep~

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hnn—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Okay, let me wash my face.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I wish you could be this stoked about getting up back at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Not happening~ We're on the job right now. I don't do this on my days off~

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We need to help them rebuild...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hey, Lava...? I'm not dreaming now, am I? Who's that outside the window?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Mommy, mommy! Hurry! We'll be late for story time!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Okay, okay. Slow down now, or you'll hurt yourself.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I'll be fine! Hurry up!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I-Is that her mother...? Her mother's okay?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Uh, maybe...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Look at the roof over there. I could swear the eaves were damaged by Arts yesterday.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You're kidding...?

steps.name: Villager A
steps.text: Rice cakes fresh out of the steamer! Packed with sesame filling!

steps.name: Villager B
steps.text: Sweet rice! Come get your fermented sweet rice right here!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What's going on...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hmm... Everything's back to normal?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactors?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactors, you remember me, do you not? Please tell me this is not a nightmare!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Slow down, what are you—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Oh, thank goodness you two remember me! Please, hear me out. When I woke up, it was as though everything that had transpired yesterday had never occurred! Everything was in perfect order!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: The Ink Spirits attacked? Families devastated? None of it ever happened! Look, even Ah Jan's mother is walking around in one piece, hale and whole! Gave me quite a start, I tell you! I thought I'd come upon a ghost in broad daylight—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —Right! Have you perchance seen the wandering monk, Saga? Where is she? Is she well?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I haven't seen her yet—Oh, hello, Ah Jan.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Why, hello, Little Ah Jan~!

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Hm? Who are you, Mister? How do you know my name?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactors, look! This is exactly what I meant!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hey, Ah Jan, we're here to listen to Mr. Umbrella-Boiler's stories. How come story time is over already?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Oh, I see. The storyteller is sick today. My mommy is staying to help take care of him. Most of the people who came for his stories are staying to help, too.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's a shame.

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: It really is!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ah Jan? This gentleman actually missed the session yesterday. Do you remember what the story was about?

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: I wasn't here yesterday. I was flying my kite with my mommy the whole day.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's too bad, then. It looks like you're out of luck.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: H-Haha... Little Ah Jan? You don't know me? You must be playing!

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Who are you, Mister? Oh, you must be the one who just moved into the house down the street!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: N-Never you mind. Please, go on, frolic as you do...

steps.name: Little Girl
steps.text: Hm? Okay. See you, mister!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Why are we the only ones who remember anything...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No idea, but look at how cheerful she is. This isn't so bad.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Well... *Sigh*... That I certainly have no qualms with, but, my benefactor, are you not being a little too... calm?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is this what the clerk meant when she said that...catching the moon in the water thing?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Anyway, I think... I have a pretty good guess where Saga is.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Oh my! This sesame soup is unlike anything I've ever tasted! Simply exquisite! Wouldst thou like some, shopkeep?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I'll pass. I'm not too fond of sweets myself. Please, don't worry about me. Just enjoy it yourself.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I see. 'Tis a shame, but pray mind not if I do—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Saga!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Whoa—

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Lava, why the commotion? I well nigh spilled my sesame soup...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So... you remember who I am?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Beg pardon?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Oh... I see. That must have left you quite flabbergasted.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Master, do you know what's happened?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: As I said before, I have spent many a moon inside this scroll. It can hardly be called an astute observation.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: For those not originally from the scroll, suppose we all have an eye each. With four of us, and that makes four eyes.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: As we fall asleep, we close our eyes. With that, there is no longer anyone gazing upon its scenery... and slowly it returns to the way it was. By the time we open our eyes and lay them upon it yet again, everything has gone back to its original shape and form.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: 'Tis what happens every time we awaken here. I have long grown accustomed to this anomaly.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So... we're really inside a... painting?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Hm? Have I not said as much?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Saga, is this going to affect our thought process... the way we think?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Hm, now I wonder? Naught has ever seemed particularly strange to me...?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: That's just how you've always been.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Thanks to your monastery's head priest, you're no less familiar with world affairs despite your isolation from the outside world. On the contrary. Since you left Higashi, each step you've taken helped broaden your horizons, and though you may be directionless, you have never let that dampen your spirits.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: When life gives you lemons, if you then proceed to make lemonade, you would of course think nothing of them.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: To most people, this is nothing but a dream. The longer you're here, the easier it is to forget the things that should have been natural. The longer you're here, the more you come to accept the place as natural.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: In the end, you come to know the painting, and the painting comes to know you. You have become one with the painting, never to leave again.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Oh! So this is what you meant when you had me look for Lava! My, my. How dimwitted of me.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Hey, Lava? I noticed it yesterday, but... there's no Originium here.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I can't imagine building a village of this size without any Originium at all. Not even villages without any kind of mobility, in the most remote parts of Yan where Catastrophes rarely happen, can get by without any.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Right...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hold on, Dawn, what about you?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I am but a local shopkeeper.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But you remember everything that happened yesterday...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: To me, yesterday is today, and today is still tomorrow.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I promised her as much, after all...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I know that I am not the real 'me,' but does it matter? That doesn't change who I am.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My apologies, but I'm afraid... you've lost me.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Out of the goodness of your hearts, you gave this village the helping hand it needed in its time of need, but... it was all futile and pointless.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Sorry for not being more forthcoming before. At the time, we still had a guest in P'o-shan. It looks like she is already gone, though.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I'm sorry you had to go through such a fright yesterday. It must have been a disaster.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Hm? That guest thou speakest of... It cannot be...?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: That's all I can say, I'm afraid.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Very well. Methinks I know who it is.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Let's stop it with the riddles—Okay, let's say this is really just a painting. How did we get here?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I'm afraid I can't give you the answer to that either.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My goodness. What are we meant to do with all this secrecy?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is that because... the people you've mentioned... are one and the same?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Excellent deduction.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Where is she?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Not here.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Who is she...?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You know her.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You mean...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Shh.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Do not speak her name, please.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: She's not one to do something like this without cause. Actually, she usually tries to avoid trouble when she can.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I suppose you've crossed paths with her before...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Yes... And if it's her, then it all makes sense...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: This P'o-shan is the moon in the water.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Well, even if I do not ring the bell myself, there is bound to be someone else in town who would take on that responsibility. 'Tis a shame... I quite enjoy ringing bells myself.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is this... the signal that the Ink Spirits are about to attack?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Yes, and it might have been because I told you the truth... But now that you know the residents here can't be harmed, this should be much easier than it was yesterday.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Just find somewhere to hide. You could also go east. to the Tung-shêng River. There is nothing there. It's a safe place for you to hide.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Be extra careful, though. If you go any further east past the easternmost part of the river, you will reach Mt. Hung-tung to the west of here.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: The Ink Spirits should calm down before long.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: So what are these monsters?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: They are the brushstrokes she sprawls when she is in a bad mood. You could say they are her musings.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: F-Find a place to hide? I'd rather not sit back and watch that all happen again...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You saw Little Ah Jan crying her eyes out. It was heartbreaking, I tell you...

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: Just remember this is all fake.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What if it's not?

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: You have seen it with your own eyes that it is.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Still though...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Still though, I don't want to have to hear those screams again. I'm sick of it.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We just need to go west and take care of all those monsters over there, right?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Exactly! If it puts our minds at ease, why does it matter if we fish the moon in the water?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I shall go with you!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: W-Wait!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Calm down~ If we just take it slow, this actually isn't all that hard~ Right, Nothing, mate?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: H-Haha, I'll be sure to lend my assistance this time...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Wait! Hold on, my benefactor! You forgot your crossbow!

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: She has the right of it.

steps.name: Dawn
steps.text: I just can't imagine why you have to keep these good people in here...
